entries.symptom: A root-level npm command fails or uses the wrong dependency graph.
entries.cause: This repository has independent frontend and backend packages and no root package.json.
entries.prevention: Run npm commands from frontend/ or backend/ and use that package's lockfile.

entries.symptom: A focused tutor evaluation passes but a later full gate exposes a regression.
entries.cause: Focused --ids runs omit intent floors, must-pass cases, and full-dataset eligibility evidence.
entries.prevention: Use focused cases while iterating, then run the unfiltered 50-case --gate before changing model eligibility or completing the phase. Rerun the baseline verifier after final formatting or any edit to a fingerprinted quality-contract file.
entries.evidence: backend/scripts/eval-tutor.ts rejects --ids/--limit with --gate; Phase 0D passed 50/50, and CI later caught a legitimate fingerprint change caused by final formatting after approval.

entries.symptom: Validation unexpectedly uses an obsolete Node runtime and fails on syntax supported by the project's configured toolchain.
entries.cause: A login shell can reorder PATH and replace the active project runtime with an older system Node installation.
entries.prevention: Run harness composites in a non-login shell that preserves the active project toolchain, and print node --version when diagnosing runtime-sensitive failures.
entries.evidence: During Phase 0D CI repair, bash -lc selected Node 18.12.0 and failed on import.meta.dirname while bash -c preserved the project runtime and completed the 50-case gate.
entries.enforcement: .github/workflows/ci.yml pins Node through setup-node; the harness preserves and records the invoked command

entries.symptom: The tutor evaluator exits immediately because no OpenAI evaluation key is visible.
entries.cause: The configured key lives in the repository root .env and a process started from backend/ does not load it automatically.
entries.prevention: Load ../.env into the process environment without printing it before running npm run eval:tutor; never echo or persist the value.
entries.evidence: backend/scripts/eval-tutor.ts getApiKey() and a verified local Phase 0D focused/full run.
entries.enforcement: Secret rejection in scripts/agent-harness.mjs; evaluator fails closed when absent

entries.symptom: Database verification diverges because agents assume a global Supabase CLI or push to an unverified target.
entries.cause: The authenticated CLI is intentionally invoked through npx, while remote project selection and migration order remain separate safety decisions.
entries.prevention: Use npx --yes supabase@2.110.0, inspect CLI/project state first, make forward migrations, test locally or in disposable Postgres, and verify the intended remote project before any push.
entries.evidence: supabase/migrations/, current authenticated local CLI setup, and Phase 0D reservation integration tests.
entries.enforcement: Migration-only database workflow plus RLS/integration tests

entries.symptom: A single Playwright CI shard fails while the rest of the matrix passes.
entries.cause: Some failures are shard-local nondeterminism, but repeated failures can also expose shared identity, teardown, focus, or timing defects.
entries.prevention: Rerun the specific failed shard once and inspect its trace; if it repeats, diagnose it as a product or test-isolation bug instead of weakening the assertion or rerunning the whole matrix blindly.
entries.enforcement: Shard-scoped CI identities, trace artifacts, and targeted rerun policy

entries.symptom: Closing a child dialog returns focus behind or outside its still-open parent dialog.
entries.cause: Independent focus restoration does not account for stacked modal ownership.
entries.prevention: Treat nested dialogs as a stack, restore focus to the parent's active control, and verify keyboard focus after both child close and final parent close.
entries.evidence: Phase 0C stacked modal focus regression and its focused browser test.
entries.enforcement: Modal focus regression coverage in the frontend/e2e suites

entries.symptom: A course-registry diff appears after development or build commands.
entries.cause: frontend/public/courses/registry.json is a generated cache, not the source of truth.
entries.prevention: Change course folders and authoring sources, run content verification, and do not commit the generated registry cache.
entries.enforcement: .gitignore plus frontend content-lint and solution verification
